spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time,
  -- Health Score calibrated for Class 1 (0.75kW)
  -- 100% at 0.71 mm/s, dropping toward 0% as it nears 4.5 mm/s
  ROUND(GREATEST(0, 100 
    - (GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z) / 4.5 * 100)
  )) AS health_percent,
  
  CASE 
    WHEN temperature > 60 THEN 'CRITICAL: OVERHEAT'
    WHEN vibration_z > 1.8 THEN 'ALARM: Axial Misalignment'
    WHEN (vibration_x > 1.8 OR vibration_y > 1.8) THEN 'WARNING: Radial Unbalance/Looseness'
    ELSE 'SYSTEM OPTIMAL'
  END AS ai_voice
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  time, 
  vibration_x AS "X-Radial (Horizontal)", 
  vibration_y AS "Y-Radial (Vertical)", 
  vibration_z AS "Z-Axial (Alignment)"
FROM motor_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  CASE 

  WHEN vibration_y > 2.8 AND vibration_y > vibration_x THEN 
    'Vertical Looseness detected. High Y-axis energy suggests loose mounting bolts or Soft Foot condition.'
    -- Scenario 1: High Temperature
    WHEN temperature > 60 THEN 'Thermal overload detected. High risk of bearing lubricant breakdown. Check cooling fan.'
    
    -- Scenario 2: Axial (Z) is the leader
    WHEN vibration_z > vibration_x 
         AND vibration_z > vibration_y 
         AND vibration_z > 2.8 
         THEN 'Axial vibration is dominant. This pattern strongly suggests a coupling misalignment or thrust bearing wear.'
    
    -- Scenario 3: Radial (X or Y) is the leader
    WHEN (vibration_x > 2.8 OR vibration_y > 2.8) 
         THEN 'Radial vibration detected. Likely cause: Rotor unbalance or loose mounting bolts. Inspect motor base.'
    
    -- Scenario 4: All Good
    ELSE 'Vibration signatures are harmonized. Motor is operating within ISO 10816-3 Zone A (Optimal).'
  END AS ai_commentary
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  time AS "Time",
  CASE 
    WHEN temperature > 60 THEN 'Thermal Overload'
    WHEN vibration_z > 1.8 THEN 'Axial Misalignment'
    WHEN vibration_y > 1.8 THEN 'Vertical Looseness'
    WHEN vibration_x > 1.8 THEN 'Horizontal Unbalance'
  END AS "Fault Type",
  CASE 
    WHEN temperature > 60 THEN 'Immediate Shutdown: High risk of fire or winding failure.'
    WHEN vibration_z > 4.5 THEN 'CRITICAL: Vibration causing damage to motor (Zone D).'
    WHEN vibration_z > 1.8 THEN 'Urgent: Bearings and couplings under stress (Zone C).'
    WHEN vibration_y > 1.8 THEN 'Caution: Foundation bolts are loose; inspect mounting.'
    WHEN vibration_x > 1.8 THEN 'Maintenance: Schedule a cleaning or balancing.'
  END AS "Urgency Level"
FROM motor_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND (
    vibration_x > 1.8 OR
    vibration_y > 1.8 OR
    vibration_z > 1.8 OR
    temperature > 60
  )
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT count(*) AS "Total Anomalies"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z) as peak_vibration_,
    AVG(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) + 
    (STDDEV(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 3) as upper_bound
  FROM motor_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
) AS sub
WHERE peak_vibration_ > upper_bound 
  AND peak_vibration_ > 0.5 -- This "Floor" ignores background noise below 0.5mm/s

SELECT status_label 
FROM machine_activity_logs 
ORDER BY changed_at DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  time,
  voltage AS "Voltage (v)",
  current AS "Amps (A)",
  torque AS "Torque (%)",
  power AS "Power (kW)",
  temperature AS "Temp (°C)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  time,
  speed_command_hz AS "Set Frequency (Command)",
  frequency AS "Actual Frequency"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  time,
  rpm AS "Shaft Speed (RPM)",
  power AS "Real Power (kW)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  time,
  voltage AS "Voltage (V)",
  frequency AS "Operating Frequency (Hz)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  time,
  current AS "Current (A)",
  torque AS "Torque (%)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

spec.title: 3-Axis Vibration Acceleration
spec.description: Acceleration from WTVB01-485 registers 0x34-0x36. More sensitive than velocity to high-frequency impacting (early bearing defects). Velocity (panel 11) remains the ISO 10816 severity metric.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  accel_x AS "X Acceleration (g)",
  accel_y AS "Y Acceleration (g)",
  accel_z AS "Z Acceleration (g)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

spec.title: Dominant Vibration Frequency vs Shaft Speed
spec.description: Dashed line is 1x running speed from VFD RPM. A dominant frequency that TRACKS the dashed line is speed-synchronous (imbalance / misalignment / looseness). One that sits above and does NOT track it suggests a bearing defect frequency. Sensor is rated from 5 Hz - below that, frequency readings are unreliable.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  vib_freq_x AS "X Dominant Freq (Hz)",
  vib_freq_y AS "Y Dominant Freq (Hz)",
  vib_freq_z AS "Z Dominant Freq (Hz)",
  rpm / 60.0 AS "1x Running Speed (Hz)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

spec.title: 3-Axis Vibration Displacement
spec.description: Displacement in micrometres. Most useful for low-frequency mechanical looseness. Expect small values on a healthy motor.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  disp_x AS "X Displacement (um)",
  disp_y AS "Y Displacement (um)",
  disp_z AS "Z Displacement (um)"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time ASC

spec.title: Vibration Sensor Chip Temp
spec.description: SENSOR self-temperature (register 0x40), NOT motor temperature. Motor temperature is the Temp (C) field in panel 17, read from D230.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  sensor_chip_temp AS "Sensor Chip Temp"
FROM motor_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  time, 
  peak_vibration,
  moving_avg + (std_dev * 3) AS upper_bound,
  moving_avg - (std_dev * 3) AS lower_bound,
  moving_avg
FROM (
  SELECT 
    time, 
    -- We monitor the Max value across all 3 axes for total protection
    GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z) as peak_vibration,
    AVG(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as moving_avg,
    STDDEV(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as std_dev
  FROM motor_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
) AS stats
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 
  time, 
  peak_vibration AS anomaly
FROM (
  SELECT 
    time, 
    GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z) as peak_vibration,
    AVG(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) + 
    (STDDEV(GREATEST(vibration_x, vibration_y, vibration_z)) 
        OVER(ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 3) as upper_bound
  FROM motor_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
) AS sub
WHERE peak_vibration > upper_bound
ORDER BY time
